plugins.name: Flow Sim
plugins.description: Turns a user flow spanning several services or repositories into an animated, self-contained HTML page showing who taps what, which service calls which, what is written or queued, and what returns by webhook or callback. Every hop is backed by a file, line, and commit, or drawn as unverified with an open question.

install.notes: Clone morning-song/setlist and copy skills/flow-sim/ into your project's .claude/skills/ directory. Requires Node 18+.
